scoring_justification: The headline is a single computed dimensionless factor; recomputing the full numerical integration from raw grid data is infeasible without standardizing the grid and solver; result-level compare against the paper-reported value is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference dimensionless force factor for q=0.04
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 1949, vol. 199, p. 113, area under curve of figure 3 is given as 0.68 in non-dimensional units.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from the paper text; the value is 0.68.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the exact value the paper reports for the perturbation force factor at q=0.04, used as the hidden gold.

outputs.description: Dimensionless perturbation force factor F/(A mu c0) computed at q=0.04. The checker compares the factor to a hidden gold value with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The dimensionless force factor for q=0.04 computed from the approximate solution. The checker compares the factor to a hidden gold value with tolerance.

steps.description: Validate q=0.04 and factor within relative tolerance of 10% of paper gold 0.68. Score 1.0 if |factor-0.68| ≤ 0.068, linearly decreasing to 0 at 2*tolerance (0.136). Factor must be positive.
